prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If an object is approached, pick it up and check its properties. Otherwise, move to the visible object, or scan the area. Perform a specific task.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = GrabObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> </Sequence> <Sequence>                 <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />  <Action ID = PickUpItem    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForItem    /> <Condition ID = IsItemVisible    /> <Action ID = MoveToItem    /> <SubTree ID = CheckItemProperties    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsItemApproached    />     <Action ID = PickUpItem    />     <SubTree ID = CheckItemProperties    /> </Sequence> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsItemVisible    />     <Action ID = MoveToItem    /> </Sequence> <SubTree ID = PerformSpecificTask    />"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsItemApproached? THEN
				DO PickUpItem
		ELSE
			DO CheckItemProperties
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsItemVisible? THEN
				DO MoveToItem
		END
		DO ScanAreaForItem
	END
